answer: Accredited gas fitter licence with gas safety certification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. A farm running 704 aliases would need 704 separate proofs, each costing about 116 POA or 13 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The falcon sits in the mechanism itself, the gale sits in the price of faking it, and the reef sits in the record no template can forge. A farm either pays the price or stays out; either way the honest agents keep the pool.
